slides.title: A 2022 peace accord
slides.body: UN News describes the 2022 Pretoria Agreement as the accord that ended the civil war in Tigray.

slides.title: What the UN chief asked
slides.body: Secretary-General Guterres urged all parties to stop hostilities and the signatories to return to dialogue under the agreement's framework.

slides.title: Why it matters for civilians
slides.body: The UN says teams are working to get food and health care through, but hostilities are displacing people in Tigray. Verified figures are not yet available.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Keep aid routes open. Return to dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
